intent.author: workflows
intent.title: bot.github
intent.description: Named by workflow delivery_live (deliveries): the outside system github, heard as bot.github; the people its bridge relays (person.github.<login>) are their own machines, and the events that end its steps may come from them.

steps: delivery_live · ci: outside github; done when the checks' result with head sha the item's commit; success → review, failure → write; on the pull request closed unmerged → the end, closed_unmerged; on the ticket going Done → the end, abandoned; guard within 30 min, then attention

delivery_live · review: outside github; done when an approval on the pull request; done → sail; on changes asked for on the pull request → write; on a comment on the pull request with state as the setting stand_in_review says → sail; on the pull request closed unmerged → the end, closed_unmerged; on the ticket going Done → the end, abandoned; guard within 30 min, then attention

delivery_live · sail_check: outside github; done when the label SAILED on the pull request; done → close_ticket; on the label REJECTED on the pull request → triage; on the pull request closed unmerged → the end, closed_unmerged; on the ticket going Done → the end, abandoned; guard at most 3 rounds, then attention
